unify_header.title: SVP Engineering, Agentic AI Platforms
unify_header.role_narrative: Led the platform roadmap, core systems architecture, and commercialization of a production-grade generative AI Solution Accelerator within a consulting firm, serving Fortune 500 financial institutions and converting bespoke client delivery into reusable IP deployed across enterprise lines of business.

companion_unify_bullets_context.text:
- bul_unify_001: Established a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows through deterministic route-policy dispatch, GraphRAG context-pack grounding, and human override escalation paths.
- bul_unify_002: Advanced enterprise AI platform adoption through CFO-aligned adoption motions, connecting reusable workflow capabilities with usage-based forecasting and customer value realization.
- bul_unify_003: Strengthened production trust with audit-grade observability for regulated AI workflows, pairing evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls to improve runtime resilience.
- bul_unify_004: Standardized the AI solution lifecycle with production-readiness gates across intake, validation, execution, monitoring, and remediation, enabling more repeatable deployment decisions.
- bul_unify_005: Architected high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms by integrating AWS and Databricks Lakehouse pipelines with vector services and parallel decision workflows.
- bul_unify_006: Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability through agentic platform productization and a focused operating model.

narrative_sentence: Owned Unify Consulting's mandate to turn governed agentic AI architecture into an industrialized commercial engine, linking platform direction, reusable IP, partner-channel enablement, and disciplined enterprise deployment to establish durable operating models and repeatable customer value across demanding financial-services environments.
